scope: Executed isolated arithmetic, not a benchmark or execution of repository code.

worldvln_discount.interpretation: A shared positive reward scale cancels under per-group standardization without epsilon. This does not establish how the unreleased trainer groups or weights rewards.

cvaml_variance.distribution: Independent equally likely -1/+1 values; true mean 0 and variance 1; fixed scalar value function. Enumerated all 16 samples.
cvaml_variance.interpretation: The population-variance correction leaves 1/N^2 = 0.0625 in this restricted case. The real policy-dependent critic introduces additional dependencies not simulated here.

wmnav_merge.interpretation: An ordinary minimum update cannot raise a low score. The inspected goal-mask override is a distinct exception.

navq_ties.interpretation: Two equal-length paths show shortest paths need not be unique. A stored tie-broken path can still define an operational target.
